WITH OVER SIX DECADES OF EXPERIENCE, TALBROS GROUP HAS ESTABLISHED A STRONG GLOBAL PRESENCE.

Read More
VISION

Talbros Group aims to be a market leader in the automobile industry while maintaining the highest levels of employee satisfaction and stakeholder value. Continuously enhancing our product range, we aspire to be the brand of choice to our global customer base.

MISSION

We are committed to leading with affordable sealing solutions, automobile components and solutions across industries. While fostering a fulfilling workplace, we prioritize quality and customer satisfaction through trained staff and a customer-centric culture. Talbros Group is in a pursuit to develop zero defect market-driven products for automotive and non-automotive customers.

QUALITY

Renowned for its quality and commitment to excellence, Talbros Group ensures that every product is created with utmost caution to meet the highest global standards.

CUSTOMERS

Having a client base across renowned automotive and non-automotive manufacturers to individual vehicle owners, our commitment to customer satisfaction is reflected in our long-standing relationships with our global clientele including original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and tier 1 companies.

A GLOBAL PRODUCER OF AUTOMOBILE COMPONENTS

Keeping customer satisfaction and product enhancement at the forefront, Talbros Group is building its path to becoming a leading player in the global auto industry. We also share a strong presence spanning across 500+ countries and have built a diligent and resourceful team of over 2000 employees.

STOCK PRICE

Talbros Automotive Components Limited places a paramount focus on creating value and giving back to the stakeholders. By aligning business strategies with the interests of shareholders, customers, employees, and the broader community, we are able to foster a sustainable growing and successful environment.

We intend to positively impact our stakeholders and those involved in the ecosystem through transparent communication, ethical practices, and striving for excellence. This not only strengthens relationships but also reinforces the company's position as a responsible and value-driven entity in the automotive industry.
